name: IKEA LACK side table, 55x55 cm

sources.what: product page (article 304.499.08; 21 5/8 x 21 5/8 x 17 3/4 in, max load 22 lb)
assembly instructions (AA-2606170-1, 2025; 4 pages: 1 illustrated + 3 pages of multilingual warnings)
assembly instructions, older edition (AA-207276-4, 2006; 1 page, same content)
community FreeCAD model (not opened; license unverified)

overallDimsMm.note: x=width, y=depth, z=height; from the product page (55x55 cm, H 45 cm / 17 3/4 in)

parts.name: tabletop
parts.material: board-on-frame (particleboard/fibreboard skins over paper honeycomb fill), painted
parts.notes: 50 mm thickness is the widely used community figure (450 total - 400 leg); not on the IKEA page. Pre-drilled pilot hole near each corner on the underside.

parts.name: leg
parts.notes: Square section 50 mm and length 400 mm are community-measured (3D-printer-enclosure builds), not IKEA-published. Pre-drilled centre hole in the top end.

hardware.size: double-ended wood dowel screw (hanger bolt with wood thread both ends and a centre collar), IKEA part 115980, approx M6-class x ~70 mm (length estimated from the drawing)
hardware.notes: Counted from the instructions parts callout '4x 115980'. No tools needed; driven by hand into the top, then the leg is spun onto the protruding end.

joins.notes: Each leg: one double-ended dowel screw, half into the tabletop underside corner, half into the leg end. Leg axis vertical, inset at each corner flush with the top's edges.

assembly.stepsSource: official instructions AA-2606170-1: one un-numbered illustrated panel (parts callout 4x 115980, screw into top, spin leg on), plus a 'work on a soft surface' panel; remaining pages are warnings (do not sit, max load 10 kg)
order: lay tabletop upside down on a soft surface
hand-thread 4 dowel screws into the corner pilot holes
spin each leg onto its screw until tight

referenceCad.license: unverified (search snippet said public domain; page returned 403, so not confirmed)

confidence: high for overall dims, max load (10 kg / 22 lb), part count (1 top + 4 legs), hardware (4x part 115980 double-ended screw) and single-panel assembly - read directly from the IKEA page and both instruction editions. medium for 50 mm top thickness and 50x50x400 legs (consistent community figures, not IKEA-published). low for the screw's thread size/length (estimated from the drawing).
notes: Simplest possible flat-pack: 5 parts, 4 identical joints, no allen key. Legs are on the corners, so the leg pattern is 4 points at (+/-250, +/-250) mm from centre if legs are flush with the top edge (derived from 550 top and 50 legs).
